source: docs/research/plot.md (Elzer/Carberry intended messages, FT Visual Vocabulary, Amar tasks, Munzner)

message.q: What should the reader conclude from this panel? (family/type)

labels.compare/ranking: ours is best among several methods
labels.compare/gap: ours beats a named baseline by a margin
labels.compare/parity: we match a stronger or costlier method
labels.compare/consistency: the win holds across tasks, datasets or seeds
labels.attribute/ablation: removing or changing component X costs this much
labels.attribute/decomposition: a total broken into parts (error, compute, time)
labels.trend/scaling: a smooth (often power-law) relation with scale
labels.trend/dynamics: behaviour over training steps or time
labels.trend/monotone: steady gain or degradation as X increases
labels.regime/crossover: A wins below x*, B wins above
labels.regime/emergence: a sudden change or phase transition at a threshold
labels.regime/failure-onset: a method breaks beyond some point
labels.tradeoff/budget-curve: quality as a function of a budget (steps, latency, memory)
labels.robustness/insensitivity: results are flat across a hyperparameter or perturbation range
labels.robustness/sensitivity: results depend sharply on a setting
labels.robustness/variance: spread across seeds, prompts or runs
labels.association/agreement: agreement with humans or with theory
labels.characterize/distribution: the shape of a distribution (tails, modes)
labels.characterize/structure: structure in embeddings, attention, activations or layers
labels.characterize/failure-mode: where and how things go wrong
labels.theory/prediction-match: empirical results match a bound or predicted rate
labels.theory/toy-confirmation: a toy setting shows the mechanism
labels.exemplify/qualitative: samples or examples that illustrate a point
